name: Video Grain
mechanism:
This method analyzes video grain (film grain / sensor noise) for forensic detection:

1. **Grain模式提取**: The fine-grained noise/grain pattern is extracted by separating the high-frequency stochastic component from image structure using adaptive filtering. The grain's spatial and statistical characteristics are measured.

2. **GrainModel分析**: The grain model (size, intensity, spatial frequency content, color characteristics) is identified. Camera sensor noise has specific properties: (a) Gaussian-Poisson distribution, (b) sensor-dependent spatial correlation, (c) color-dependent characteristics (more noise in blue channel). The method checks if the grain follows a physical sensor noise model.

3. **Grain空间Homogeneity**: Camera grain should be spatially homogeneous (uniform sensor produces uniform noise). The method checks grain homogeneity across the frame — different grain characteristics in the face vs. background indicate compositing of content from different sources.

4. **Grain时间Behavior**: Camera grain is temporally random (uncorrelated between frames) and should renew completely each frame. The method checks temporal grain independence. AI-generated grain may show temporal correlations — persistent grain patterns across frames or correlated grain changes.

5. **Grain-信号Interaction**: Real camera grain is multiplicative (signal-dependent) — brighter regions show more shot noise. The method checks grain-signal dependency. AI generators often add additive noise (signal-independent) or no noise at all, producing an unrealistic grain-signal relationship detectable as a forensic indicator.
parameters:
分析类型: sensor
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through 视频 grain analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
